panel_fill_rate: How fast the disk is filling
panel_disk_body: {free} free of {total}, and nothing is filling it fast.
panel_nothing_yet: Nothing has reported on this yet.
panel_dead_scope: Nothing in this box can be trusted right now. Everything else on this page still can.
check_tunnel_title: Your downloading is hidden from your internet provider
check_tunnel_prose: Your downloads appear to come from {address} in {country}, not from your home address. If the tunnel ever drops, downloading stops rather than falling back to your own line.
check_quiet_prose: {service} last answered {span} ago. Nothing is broken yet, but any figure it gave is the last one it had, not what is true now.
check_stuck_title: A download is stuck, and won't try again on its own
check_stuck_prose: {release} finished downloading but couldn't be filed into your library. {service} tried twice, then gave up. Nearly always this is a permissions problem when linking the file.
check_fill_rate_title: How fast your disk is filling has never been measured
check_fill_rate_prose: Until it has been, the day it runs out cannot be worked out. That is not the same as there being plenty of room.
check_scan_title: Your library is being read for the first time
check_scan_prose: {done} of {total} folders have been walked. Figures on this page will be incomplete until it finishes.
setting_boot_prose: Your stack comes back on its own after a power cut or a reboot.
setting_files_prose: {path} — one disk, which is what lets downloads be linked into your library instead of copied.
setting_tunnel_drop_title: Stop downloading if the tunnel drops
setting_tunnel_drop_prose: Can't be turned off. Your download programs live inside the tunnel, so there is no route out without it.
note_quota: A limit stops one person filling the disk on their own. It resets on the first of the month.
note_backup: This backs up your settings — which programs run, your quality choices, who's in the household. Not your films; those are far too big.
banner_contact_prose: Nothing is trying again on its own. What is below is what lemonfiber said when the page was asked to draw it.
figure_one_running: one download running, one gone quiet
panel_programs: The programs that run your stack
service_gluetun: Hides your downloading from your provider
service_prowlarr: Finds where things can be downloaded from
sub_quotas: How much they can ask for
schematic_lands_on: and what they fetch lands on
field_provider_reached: Reached it, and your details work
field_at_once_hint: Your provider allows {allowed}. Asking for more gets refused; fewer just downloads more slowly.
person_owner: Can change anything · signed in now
person_asker: Can ask for things · last watched {span} ago
person_child: Can ask, needs your approval · nothing above {rating}
person_guest: Can watch, can't ask · expires in {days} days
word_unanswered: lemonfiber hasn't said what this word means.
word_no_entry: lemonfiber has no entry for this word.
unlock_prose: Two things open this page: a password, or the key lemonfiber printed when it started serving.
wayin_signin_prose: Anybody the household holds an account for signs in here, and so does the operator. What this page then shows is decided by the account, not by a setting on it.
wayin_name_hint: Leave this empty to sign in as the operator of this machine.
wayin_not_recognised_lead: That name and password were not recognised.
wayin_not_recognised_prose: Try them again. This page is not told which of the two was not recognised, and it is not told which accounts exist.
wayin_declined_lead: lemonfiber would not open this page.
unlock_refused_lead: This run would not take what this page was holding.
unlock_refused_prose: A key lasts as long as the run that printed it, and a session lasts until it runs out or the password behind it changes. Sign in again, or paste the key the run now serving printed.
unlock_hint: It is a long word of letters and numbers, on the line that says where lemonfiber is listening.
flow_opening_prose: Everything below is what lemonfiber said when the page was asked to draw it.
flow_stale_prose: Every figure below is the last one confirmed, not what is true now.
telemetry_degraded_lead: Some of what is below could not be read.
telemetry_degraded_prose: Each panel lemonfiber could not fill says so inside its own border. The rest are current.
telemetry_disconnected_lead: lemonfiber cannot reach the container engine.
telemetry_disconnected_prose: Nothing below is being refreshed. Starting and stopping still work.
telemetry_none_prose: Your stack is set up and none of it is up. Start what you want below.
telemetry_unset_lead: Nothing has been set up yet.
telemetry_unset_prose: There is nothing to draw until there is a stack to draw it from.
telemetry_unrecognised_lead: This page has no word for what lemonfiber said about itself.
telemetry_unrecognised_prose: Everything below is what lemonfiber said when the page was asked to draw it.
standing_unrecognised: Not a grading this page knows
condition_unrecognised: in a state this page has no word for
space_until_full: Full in {span} at the rate it is filling.
link_unrecognised: in a way this page has no word for
stall_redownload_loop: The same thing keeps being downloaded again
stall_repeated_import_failure: It downloaded, but filing it keeps failing
stall_completed_not_imported: It downloaded, and was never filed
stall_orphaned: It downloaded, and nothing claims it
stall_waiting_indefinitely: It has been waiting with nothing happening
stall_unrecognised: It is stuck in a way this page has no word for
running_controls: What you can ask of part of your stack
running_asked: What you have asked lemonfiber to do
confirm_stop_title: Stop every program in your stack?
confirm_stop_prose: Downloads stop where they are, whatever they were serving goes offline, and anyone watching is cut off. Nothing is deleted, and starting it again brings all of it back.
work_under_way: lemonfiber took this on and runs it apart from this page, so closing the tab would not stop it. It is called {job}, and this page keeps asking what became of it.
work_done: lemonfiber finished this while you waited.
forms_none: Your stack lists nothing it can run.
running_whole_controls: What you can ask of all of it
running_scope_none: Nothing is chosen above, so starting and stopping act on your whole stack. The other three need something chosen first.
running_scope_some: These act on what you chose above, and nothing else.
action_pull_chosen: Fetch newer versions of what you chose
action_seed: Wire your programs to each other
doing_seed_title: Wiring your programs to each other
work_finished: lemonfiber finished {job}. What it changed shows up in the panels below.
work_forgotten: This run has no work called {job} any more. Either it was never handed out, or lemonfiber has been restarted since — nothing carries a job across a restart.
work_adrift: This page could not ask what became of {job}. {said}
overall_healthy_prose: Nothing below needs you. Each line says what was checked and what was seen.
overall_degraded_prose: Nothing is broken. Some of what was checked is worth knowing about.
overall_broken_prose: At least one check failed. Each one below says what it means and what to do about it.
overall_unknown_lead: Some of it could not be checked.
overall_unknown_prose: Nothing below should be read as everything being well — some of the checks could not run at all.
overall_unrecognised_lead: This run came to a word this page does not know.
overall_unrecognised_prose: Each check below still says how it turned out, so read those rather than this line.
outcome_unrecognised: Not a word this page knows
category_unrecognised: Not a family this page knows
panel_disk_findings: What was checked about your disk
storage_none: No check about the disk has reported in.
logs_none: No program has said anything yet.
logs_ended: What your programs had said when this screen asked. Nothing is following them, so anything said since is not here.
requests_nobody: Nobody has asked for anything yet.
requests_unread: The list of requests could not be read. This is not a household that has asked for nothing; it is one nothing could be read from.
request_state_unrecognised: lemonfiber has no word for what the request service called this
panel_front_door: The one address to hand out
door_stranded: Answering, with no address to hand out
door_none: Nothing is published to the house
door_unrecognised: Standing in a way this page has no word for
door_derived: Worked out from what your stack runs.
door_named: You chose {door}, and this is it.
door_refused: You chose {named}, and this stack will not send anybody there. {because}
door_chosen_unrecognised: How this came to be the door is not something this page has a word for.
door_beside: What else the house can reach
tunnel_leaking: Your downloading is not going through it
tunnel_leaving_from: Your downloading leaves from here, not from your home line.
tunnel_mismatch: Your download program is going out by another route, and your home line is that route.
tunnel_port_none: No port forwarded, so fewer people can reach you to share with
head_why_not_the_door: Why it is not the door
facing_shelf: One kind of thing, reached from the library
facing_operators: An index over every program, the ones the house should never see among them
facing_unstated: Published to the house, and nothing says what it is to them
facing_unrecognised: Something this page has no word for
panel_household: Who is in the house, and what they asked for
household_nothing_waiting: Nothing is waiting for you to rule on.
household_requests_unread: The request service could not be asked, so nothing here says what anyone is waiting on.
requests_member_unread: What they asked for could not be read.
household_policy_trusted: Everything the house asks for arrives, and nothing is counted against anybody.
household_policy_within_a_limit: What the house asks for arrives until the period's limit is spent.
household_policy_everything_waits: Everything the house asks for waits for you to rule on it.
household_policy_unrecognised: What happens to what the house asks for is not something this page has a word for.
household_policy_unread: The request service could not be asked, so what happens to what the house asks for is not known.
held_library_limited: Held to some of your libraries.
held_both: Held to a rating, and to some of your libraries.
held_inconsistent: Can ask for things they are not allowed to watch.
held_unrecognised: Held to something this page has no word for.
unrated_held_back: Anything with no rating is held back.
unrated_let_through: Anything with no rating is let through.
unrated_unrecognised: What happens to anything with no rating is not something this page has a word for.
person_never_seen: Nobody has signed in to this account yet.
quota_unrecognised: Not a standing this page knows
household_nobody: Nobody is in the house yet.
household_unread: The house could not be read. This is not an empty house; it is one nothing could be read from.
severity_unrecognised: A weight this page has no word for
fixing_unrecognised: A standing this page has no word for
finding_from_orphaned: A check left by the {named} plugin, which is no longer installed
finding_from_unknown: Nobody could say where this check came from: {why}
finding_from_unrecognised: Nobody could say where this check came from
findings_marked: A check marked with where it came from is not one of the stack's own. Every other check is.
told_unrecognised: A turn this page has no word for
programs_less: These run like any other, and lemonfiber can do less with them
programs_left_out_prose: Your settings leave these out, which is not the same as being down. Each one runs once what it needs is set up.
needs_usenet: Needs a usenet provider, and none is set up.
needs_torrent: Needs a torrent provider, and none is set up.
needs_unrecognised: Needs something this page has no word for.
